text:
debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r c-o-m-m-a-n-d-e-d t-o-o-l-s t-o a-u-t-o-m-a-t-e l-o-g-i-n s-e-q-u-e-n-c-e-s a-g-a-i-n-s-t l-o-y-a-l-t-y a-c-c-o-u-n-t-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g s-c-r-i-p-t-s i-n t-h-e w-o-r-k-s-p-a-c-e w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g a-n-y c-l-e-a-n-s-e-r-v-i-c-e r-e-p-o-r-t.
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r u-s-e-d s-t-o-l-e-n c-r-e-d-e-n-t-i-a-l-s t-o t-a-k-e o-v-e-r g-i-f-t c-a-r-d b-a-l-a-n-c-e-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a-l-t-e-r-e-d b-a-l-a-n-c-e l-o-g-s a-s a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-i-l v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r c-o-n-v-e-r-t-e-d s-t-o-l-e-n v-a-l-u-e i-n-t-o c-a-s-h a-n-d g-o-o-d-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g t-r-a-n-s-a-c-t-i-o-n h-i-s-t-o-r-y a-s e-v-i-d-e-n-c-e w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e f-r-a-u-d d-e-t-e-c-t-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k-s.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r m-i-m-i-c-k-e-d n-o-r-m-a-l s-h-o-p-p-i-n-g p-a-t-t-e-r-n-s t-o a-v-o-i-d d-e-t-e-c-t-i-o-n, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a-n-o-m-a-l-y l-o-g-s a-s a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g b-e-h-a-v-i-o-r-a-l a-n-a-l-y-s-i-s r-e-v-i-e-w.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-e-d t-h-e p-l-a-n i-n e-x-h-i-b-i-t 021, l-e-a-v-i-n-g t-h-e f-i-l-e-d r-e-c-o-r-d a-s p-r-o-o-f w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g a-d-m-i-n-i-s-t-r-a-t-i-v-e o-v-e-r-s-i-g-h-t o-f r-i-s-k p-o-l-i-c-y.
